title: Privilege Guardrails: SSO/SAML Key Rotation, Audit Enrichment, and Support Macro Toolkit
creator: Maya Coleman
description: Create a consolidated operator-facing guide and set of support macros focused on enforcing privilege guardrails for RBAC v2. Deliverables: (1) an operational runbook for SSO/SAML key rotation and emergency key rollback that integrates with our private control plane; (2) audit log enrichment patterns and queries for rapid triage of privilege escalation attempts; (3) a set of support macros for oncall and support engineers to standardize user deprovisioning, emergency temporary elevation, and escalation to security engineering. This ticket covers content authoring, validation in the staging control plane, and a dry-run with oncall engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook v1 published in Confluence with step-by-step rotation and rollback instructions
Audit enrichment pipeline can surface 'privilege_change' and 'sso_assertion_mismatch' within 2 minutes in the security dashboard
Three support macros implemented in Intercom/HelpDesk templates and tested by oncall team
Rotation procedure dry-run completed in staging without interrupting active sessions
Security review completed and signoff from Security and Compliance leads
steps: Draft SSO/SAML key rotation procedure: precheck, rotate, publish metadata, rotate keys in control plane, validate consumers
Add emergency rollback steps: metadata reversion, consumer cache invalidation, and session reconciliation script
Design audit log enrichment fields: actor_principal, prev_role_set, role_delta, assertion_issuer_fingerprint
Implement enrichment in the audit forwarder (staging): add fields and versioned schema
Write Splunk/Datadog queries and dashboard panels for rapid detection: privilege_change, failed_assertion_count, orphaned_sessions
Author support macros for common workflows: temporary_elevation_request, immediate_deprovision, sso-troubleshoot-script
Run tabletop with oncall + SRE to iterate wording and timing; capture questions and update scripts
Ship Confluence pages, create internal announcement, and add runbook links to oncall rotation playbook
rollback_plan: If rotation causes consumer breakage, follow emergency rollback: (1) revert control-plane metadata to last known-good (timestamped) artifact; (2) run cache invalidation for edge gateways and token issuers; (3) execute session-reconciliation script to rebind tokens; (4) escalate to security lead. Notify impacted teams via #security-ops and incident bridge. Document all steps in postmortem.
test_plan: Staging rotate of test-idp (okta-test) to new key pair, validate SSO sign-in for web and api clients
Trigger simulated failed assertions and verify audit pipeline surfaces 'sso_assertion_mismatch' event
Run support macros end-to-end: submit temporary_elevation_request, validate audit trail and TTL expiry
Load test: 500 concurrent SSO handshakes during rotation window to ensure no latency spike > 300ms
